overview.description: Mahipalgad Fort (Marathi: महिपालगडा)is a fort located 20 km (12 mi)from Belgaum. It is in the Chandgad taluka of Kolhapur district, of Maharashtra. This fort is an important fort in Kolhapur district. The fort is situated on the mountain ridge close to the line dividing Maharashtra and Karnataka state.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Mahipalgad?
faq.a: The best time to visit Mahipalgad is Nov – Feb. Summers are 26–36°C and winters are 22–32°C.

The nearest airport is Mahipalgad / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Vasco da Gama (Goa) (83 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Mahipalgad at a relaxed pace.
